Doctor Hudson is like the old school GP I remember having when I was growing up but have long since thought didn’t exist anymore. A GP who knows her patients & who is interested in getting to know them as a whole. She treats us all with respect & listens to our concerns & is very thorough in her care.

If I need to call the surgery on the phone I might have to wait to get through, but when I do speak to someone I always find the staff very willing to help. In person, staff are kind & professional & don’t mind my asking questions.

In my experience the nursing team always seem to be running to good time, but yet I never feel like they are rushing us in and out.

I spend more time at Friarwood Surgery than I do my own, & if I lived closer, I’d consider transferring there myself!",null,[0,191]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25obFdFbElZbEpmWnpVdGNrMVpYM2RvVG1sd2FGRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x3166e03b6b9a734b!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOnhlWElIYlJfZzUtck1ZX3doTmlwaFE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25obFdFbElZbEpmWnpVdGNrMVpYM2RvVG1sd2FGRRAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwi8u4_aoLCTAxULEWMBHfoiB_wQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwi8u4_aoLCTAxULEWMBHfoiB_wQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESYENBRVFBUnBDUTJrNFNVRlNTVzVEWjI5QlVEY3lSMDFpWTBSSmFsOWZSV2hFU2xjd01HOHpiV2h1WHpCbFlXUlhTVUZCUVVGQlIyZG1YMEZ0VFdKalJFbHFSMEZCYVVGQg=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25CcE1XTlhkRzQwYTFoa01tUlhVRVZ1VEhaTWRGRRAB",["0x0:0x3166e03b6b9a734b",null,1772703041360640,1772703041360640,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/113084803724625569928/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Charlie Jenkins","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUGD6BqaM3IouMnu8HKO1vhXOxO_g0dVzcxA3-5CiuLg4CXZqXXbA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/113084803724625569928?hl=en"],"113084803724625569928",null,1,0,null,[0,2,1],0,["1 review",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwi8u4_aoLCTAxULEWMBHfoiB_wQ7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"2 weeks ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Friar wood surgery doesn't believe in mental health care and life saving medication.
